title: Overnight child care in licensed occupancies: NBC(AE) and NFC(AE) requirements
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: April 2024 (platform created April 2, 2024, last updated April 2, 2024)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies NBC(AE) and NFC(AE) requirements for occupancies licensed to provide overnight child care services.
Changes to Early Learning and Child Care Act regulations in early 2021 expanded accommodations for overnight child care, and the interpretation applies the Safety Codes Act to them.
The Interpretation section sets out separate requirement lists, beginning with residential occupancy (dayhome) items such as smoke alarms and carbon monoxide alarms.
Fire-alarm requirements quoted in the document include a child care facility, including a daycare facility, with an occupant load more than 40 in a building not sprinklered throughout.
